$comment: Per-agent model assignment. Every agent role names a tier and every tier names a `providerId/model` string resolvable against the registered model-provider registry (open-source, cloud, frontier, or local/Ollama). Swapping a backend means changing this file or the env override; no doctrine or pipeline code changes.

cheap.purpose: Drafting, execution, mechanical verification, reporting. Optimised for throughput and cost.

frontier.purpose: Architecture, planning, review, and every accept/reject decision. Optimised for judgement.
